issue.title: [build] Makefile bullseye target uses wrong guard variable (NOBUSTER instead of NOBULLSEYE)

failure.body:
### Description

`Makefile:91` gates the `bullseye` target on `$(NOBUSTER)` instead of `$(NOBULLSEYE)`. Compare with the `trixie` target which correctly uses `$(NOTRIXIE)`.

### Current code
```makefile
bullseye:
	@echo "+++ Making $@ +++"
ifeq ($(NOBUSTER), 0)          # <-- Should be $(NOBULLSEYE)
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.work bullseye
endif
```

### Impact
- Setting `NOBULLSEYE=1` will NOT skip the bullseye build as intended
- Setting `NOBUSTER=1` will inadvertently skip both buster AND bullseye builds

Note: Related to #14421 but that issue is about default values, not the wrong guard variable.

### Fix
Change `$(NOBUSTER)` to `$(NOBULLSEYE)`.

resolution.title: [agent][build] Fix Makefile bullseye target using wrong guard variable
resolution.description:
#### What I did
Fix the bullseye target guard from `$(NOBUSTER)` to `$(NOBULLSEYE)`.

#### How I did it
One-line change in `Makefile:91`. Compare with the correct trixie target which uses `$(NOTRIXIE)`.

#### How to verify it
`NOBULLSEYE=1 make bullseye` should now skip the bullseye build.

#### Which release branch to backport
master

#### Description for the changelog
Fix Makefile bullseye target incorrectly gated on NOBUSTER instead of NOBULLSEYE.

Fixes: #26403
